## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing locally (`pytest` / `npm test`)
- [ ] `ruff check` + `mypy` clean (backend) / `tsc --noEmit` clean (frontend)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private keys in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated when behavior or env vars changed
- [ ] Migrations are additive (or an ADR explains the destructive change)
